channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel strikes intensive care at Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
item.description: Gaza's Civil Defence says an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital has killed at least six people.

item.title: US election results could be positive for Lebanon, Hezbollah chief says
item.description: Naim Qassem says Republican losses and Israel's election result could help Lebanon maintain sovereignty.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran warns of Europe retaliation, Israel attacks Gaza
item.description: Israel orders military to step up preparations for possible attack on Iran as Tehran says it will retaliate if attacked.

item.title: Barcelona erupts in violence after general strike
item.description: Protesters hurled fireworks at police and set rubbish bins ablaze in Barcelona after Spain’s general strike.

item.title: Israeli strikes hit medical complex as nine killed across Gaza
item.description: Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis attacked as UN appeals for urgent aid to deal with heavy rains in the enclave.

item.title: Iran designates Argentinian navy, air force as ‘terrorist organisations’
item.description: The move comes months after the government of Javier Milei designated Iran's IRGC as a 'terrorist organisation'.

item.title: Hormuz Strait will ‘never return’ to pre-war status, Iran’s Ghalibaf says
item.description: Iran's parliament speaker and top negotiator says Tehran is waiting for an official US response to its seven conditions.

item.title: Oil production nears pre-Iran war levels, OPEC says
item.description: Saudi Arabia reports oil outputs soared to highest levels in months despite continued shipping disruptions.

item.title: Gaza goalkeeper killed in Israeli attack
item.description: Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Abdel-Malek was killed in an Israeli strike days after the Thousand Martyrs Cup.

item.title: Scenes show aftermath of horrific Israeli strike on Gaza tents
item.description: Palestinian families have returned to the Sabra neighbourhood of Gaza City after an Israeli strike killed three people.
